corporate social responsibility program.

on five continents. Start delivering better, value-based care today with our centralized imaging
technology.

[Get Started][37]

Our IDPS workflow is scanner agnostic with options for local and cloud data solutions. IDPS was also
among our solutions that played a part in the FIRST IN THE WORLD – HIMSS DIAM Stage 7 Accreditation
for a major, cutting-edge medical campus. See how our image-based information environment can
transform your lab workflow.

[Get Started][38]

Our fast and powerful diagnostic viewer, is built to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to
enhance reading workflow, to support diagnostic accuracy and to enrich the user experience.

[Get Started][39]

# INFINITT Multi-disciplinary Team (MDT)

Workflow software with patient-centered integrated worklist, enables physicians to view images and
documents from all departments. Optimized communication tools and screen sharing to support
telemedicine.

[Get Started][40]

# Images on any internet-connected device.

With INFINITT software, images and reports can be viewed anywhere, anytime, and on a variety of
devices. Patient consults, remote reading, clinical review; all are possible within a single
framework.

[Get Started][41]


INFINITT Cardiology Suite, a web-based PACS and reporting system for cardiology and vascular
imaging, EKG and nuclear medicine, integrates all your cardiovascular data into one solution.

[Learn More][42]


INFINITT Digital Pathology Solution (IDPS) enables quantitative image analysis and remote reading
for secondary consult and multi-disciplinary review. Facilitates collaboration, research, and the
application of AI.

[Learn More][43]


INFINITT RT PACS, a dedicated Radiotherapy Treatment image and data management solution, is
optimized to streamline workflow for oncologists, physicists, dosimetrists, therapists, and nurses.

[Learn More][44]


## Purpose-built PACS for maximum performance.

INIFITT PACS is our fastest, most-powerful diagnostic viewer, purpose-built to accelerate access and
processing speeds for radiologists. View its award-winning performance features.

[Learn More][45]

Discover our #1 award-winning RIS/PACS with advanced visualization, analysis, and reporting.

[Learn More][46]

See how our state-of-the-art cardiology suite centralizes all cardiovascular data into one solution.

[Learn More][47]

Digitize your entire pathology workflow with solutions designed to improve efficiency and

[Learn More][48]

#### “The situation is funny because everyone is so sold on other products, but those products are
#### awful compared to what I have in INFINITT PACS. For example, it takes me significantly less
#### time to make the same report in INFINITT PACS than it does in other systems. Also, for prior
#### sections, our current study comes up in INFINITT PACS, and the three priors populate the screen
#### just like they do in the other vendors’ products, but INFINITT PACS automatically populates our
#### prior fields. We looked at those priors because we brought them up on the screen, so there is
#### no reason that we should have to open our mouths to tell the voice recognition system that we
#### opened them and looked at them. There are also drop-down menus that I have built, and I can
#### click on a section in my field and select that, and I don’t even have to say a word. Reading in
#### INFINITT PACS is a breath of fresh air. There is a tremendous shortage of radiologists
#### nationwide, so anything that can make me more efficient is better, and INFINITT PACS does
#### that.”

VP/Executive

### “Overall, INFINITT has excellent products. If I were buying the same kind of products today,
### INFINITT’s product would definitely be my leading choice. I try to keep myself up to speed on
### INFINITT’s competition in case we ever decide to switch platforms, but so far, I haven’t seen
### any compelling reason to switch, even if making a switch would be easy. I am very happy with
### INFINITT. The vendor has taken a lot of our feedback and has really incorporated some changes
### that have made the product much more functional for us. The product was really good before, but
### INFINITT has done a better job of upgrading it now.”

Director

### “INFINITT’s support is very good. The vendor does exceedingly well in that area. I have had to
### make very few support calls, but when I do call, someone immediately picks up the phone and is
### on top of the issue. INFINITT’s support portal is very intuitive and easy to use. The support
### people have a large knowledge base, and they guide me in the right direction. We are a hands-on
### organization, so if we can do something without the support team, we will take a shot at it. But
### when we need assistance, someone at INFINITT immediately picks up the case.”

Manager

### “We use a different PACS at another facility, and the difference between that PACS and INFINITT
### PACS is night and day! We have so much flexibility with INFINITT PACS, and it’s the easiest
### product to integrate across facilities. Physicians who use the other PACS are now crying for
### this one!”

**George Jackson** | Operations Manager, Fader Hospital

### “I am an extremely busy radiologist, and I have dealt with many different PACS. When we
### purchased INFINITT PACS, I liked everything about it and never had buyer’s remorse. I couldn’t
### be happier with my decision several years later. I wouldn’t be able to get through my day if I
### were using another PACS. The system is amazing. I don’t have to close my case to be able to open
### another case. The system is unbelievably easy. We have a lot of surgeons who do tons of
### surgeries and send their work to us, and all of them have INFINITT PACS and love it.”

– Physician

### “INFINITT PACS is used for cardiology and radiology. Our physicians could not be happier. The
### PACS has many tools that enable the system to do multiple-department diagnoses of images.
### INFINITT Cardiology Suite is fully integrated with the PACS for imaging and transcription and
### enables us to read and diagnose remotely. The system is very easy to maintain internally, but if
### we have an issue that cannot be resolved internally, INFINITT is very quick to respond and
### resolve the issue.”

– Manager/Analyst

### “I feel that INFINITT PACS is probably the best PACS in the marketplace today. INFINITT
### continues to keep in touch with us. We talk with them on a regular basis, and they ask us what
### enhancements we would like. We have no other vendor that does that. If our physicians need the
### system to be tweaked, then INFINITT is typically very eager to make the necessary changes for
### us. We always have the most current software upgrade. INFINITT is a superb company to work with,
### and we are able to communicate with them from both the bottom up and the top down. I wish I
### could say that for our other vendors.”

– Director/Physician

#### “The situation is funny because everyone is so sold on other products, but those products are
#### awful compared to what I have in INFINITT PACS. For example, it takes me significantly less
#### time to make the same report in INFINITT PACS than it does in other systems. Also, for prior
#### sections, our current study comes up in INFINITT PACS, and the three priors populate the screen
#### just like they do in the other vendors’ products, but INFINITT PACS automatically populates our
#### prior fields. We looked at those priors because we brought them up on the screen, so there is
#### no reason that we should have to open our mouths to tell the voice recognition system that we
#### opened them and looked at them. There are also drop-down menus that I have built, and I can
#### click on a section in my field and select that, and I don’t even have to say a word. Reading in
#### INFINITT PACS is a breath of fresh air. There is a tremendous shortage of radiologists
#### nationwide, so anything that can make me more efficient is better, and INFINITT PACS does
#### that.”

VP/Executive

### “Overall, INFINITT has excellent products. If I were buying the same kind of products today,
### INFINITT’s product would definitely be my leading choice. I try to keep myself up to speed on
### INFINITT’s competition in case we ever decide to switch platforms, but so far, I haven’t seen
### any compelling reason to switch, even if making a switch would be easy. I am very happy with
### INFINITT. The vendor has taken a lot of our feedback and has really incorporated some changes
### that have made the product much more functional for us. The product was really good before, but
### INFINITT has done a better job of upgrading it now.”

Director

### “INFINITT’s support is very good. The vendor does exceedingly well in that area. I have had to
### make very few support calls, but when I do call, someone immediately picks up the phone and is
### on top of the issue. INFINITT’s support portal is very intuitive and easy to use. The support
### people have a large knowledge base, and they guide me in the right direction. We are a hands-on
### organization, so if we can do something without the support team, we will take a shot at it. But
### when we need assistance, someone at INFINITT immediately picks up the case.”

Manager

### “We use a different PACS at another facility, and the difference between that PACS and INFINITT
### PACS is night and day! We have so much flexibility with INFINITT PACS, and it’s the easiest
### product to integrate across facilities. Physicians who use the other PACS are now crying for
### this one!”

**George Jackson** | Operations Manager, Fader Hospital

### “I am an extremely busy radiologist, and I have dealt with many different PACS. When we
### purchased INFINITT PACS, I liked everything about it and never had buyer’s remorse. I couldn’t
### be happier with my decision several years later. I wouldn’t be able to get through my day if I
### were using another PACS. The system is amazing. I don’t have to close my case to be able to open
### another case. The system is unbelievably easy. We have a lot of surgeons who do tons of
### surgeries and send their work to us, and all of them have INFINITT PACS and love it.”

– Physician

### “INFINITT PACS is used for cardiology and radiology. Our physicians could not be happier. The
### PACS has many tools that enable the system to do multiple-department diagnoses of images.
### INFINITT Cardiology Suite is fully integrated with the PACS for imaging and transcription and
### enables us to read and diagnose remotely. The system is very easy to maintain internally, but if
### we have an issue that cannot be resolved internally, INFINITT is very quick to respond and
### resolve the issue.”

– Manager/Analyst

### “I feel that INFINITT PACS is probably the best PACS in the marketplace today. INFINITT
### continues to keep in touch with us. We talk with them on a regular basis, and they ask us what
### enhancements we would like. We have no other vendor that does that. If our physicians need the
### system to be tweaked, then INFINITT is typically very eager to make the necessary changes for
### us. We always have the most current software upgrade. INFINITT is a superb company to work with,
### and we are able to communicate with them from both the bottom up and the top down. I wish I
### could say that for our other vendors.”

– Director/Physician

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Transforming Radiology™

Focused on our patients. Led by our physicians. Driven by our mission.

Radiology Partners is a national radiology practice transforming radiology for radiologists,
radiology practices, hospitals, health systems, patients and families. We operate differently.
Through innovation and collaboration, Radiology Partners strives to reimagine radiology’s position
in healthcare delivery.

**Interested in a career at RP?**

[See all Opportunities][8]

**For Radiologists, Clinicians and Support Team**

We ensure our people have a voice through a culture of excellence, innovation, inclusion and
collaboration.

**For Radiology Practices**

We provide all the benefits of scale, while strengthening local practice autonomy, expertise and
relationships.

**For Hospitals and Health Systems**

We understand the need to drive and deliver value. Excellence in diagnostic imaging is what we do.

  キリデザイン。
  
  ][184]

  天井カセット形1方向
  
  天井に埋込むタイプですが下がり天井にも設置可能。風を1方向から吹き出すため壁面に近いコーナーに適し
  ています。
  
  ][185]
* [ [天井埋込ビルトイン形]
  
  天井埋込ビルトイン形
  
  天井に本体を埋込むことで照明等に左右されることなく変形空間や柱の多い空間にも設置が可能です。
  
  ][186]
* [ [天井埋込ダクト形]
  
  天井埋込ダクト形
  
  天井に本体を埋込むことでエアコンの存在感を感じさせないためインテリア重視のカフェやショップなどにオ
  ススメ。
  
  ][187]

## 業務用エアコンの形から選ぶ
* [ [天井カセット形4方向]
  
  天井カセット形4方向
  
  天井に埋込むタイプの正方形、風を4方向から吹き出してくれるので室内にムラなく風が行き渡り常に快適。
  
  ][183]
* [ [天井カセット形2方向]
  
  天井カセット形2方向
  
  天井に埋込むタイプの長方形で風を2方向から吹き出します。天井の照明等にも違和感なくフィットするスッ
  キリデザイン。
  
  ][184]
* [ [天井カセット形1方向]
  
  天井カセット形1方向
  
  天井に埋込むタイプですが下がり天井にも設置可能。風を1方向から吹き出すため壁面に近いコーナーに適し
  ています。
  
  ][185]
* [ [天井埋込ビルトイン形]
  
  天井埋込ビルトイン形
  
  天井に本体を埋込むことで照明等に左右されることなく変形空間や柱の多い空間にも設置が可能です。
  
  ][186]
* [ [天井埋込ダクト形]
  
  天井埋込ダクト形
  
  天井に本体を埋込むことでエアコンの存在感を感じさせないためインテリア重視のカフェやショップなどにオ
  ススメ。
  
  ][187]
* [ [天井吊形]
  
  天井吊形
  
  天井に吊るタイプなので天井内にスペースがなくても設置が可能。ロングかつワイド気流なので奥行きのある
  空間にオススメ。
  
  ][188]
* [ [壁掛形]
  
  壁掛形
  
  見た目は家庭用エアコンと変わりませんが風量などが格段と上がるので、店舗やオフィスなどにも使用可能。
  
  ][189]
* [ [床置形]
  
  床置形
  
  床に置いて使用するタイプなのでお掃除やメンテナンスがしやすく、スペースは多少取りますが設置工事もス
  ムーズに行えます。
  
  ][190]

# **Apollo 24|7 - Your Most Trusted Healthcare Brand**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports. 

## **The Smart Choice for Your Health is Here**

Make the best decision for your health by choosing Apollo 24|7. Here’s why you can count on us:
* 40 years of legacy in the healthcare industry
* 24x7 availability of doctors
* More than 10 million diagnostic tests each year
* 2000+ collection centres and 100+ laboratories
* High quality diagnostic solutions 
* Fast and accurate test report results
* Several medical specialties under one roof
* Order medicines and book tests online with ease
* Digitised health queries

**Ask a Doctor Online 24/7**
Online doctor consultations take place through online doctor chat, call, or video call. This helps
you to talk to doctors online from the comfort of your home by simply choosing a doctor from
different specialties. Avail personalised solutions for any health problem with prompt online doctor
consultation with Apollo 24|7.
* Safe and secure platform
* Video and chat options

**Online Doctor Consultation - Now at Your Fingertips**
The demand for doctors is expected to increase as new medicines allow people to live longer.
However, there are several ways to reach out to a doctor without the need to visit a hospital or
clinic, all thanks to technology. With the online facility available, doctor consultations have
become easier, and you can get the right health care. Online doctor consultations with 5000+ top
medical doctors are available at Apollo 24|7. Video call or chat with expert doctors from 100+
medical specialties, including | [Dermatology][99] | [Gynaecology][100] | [Paediatrics][101] |
[Psychiatry][102] | [General Physicians][103] | [Gastroenterology][104] | [Dietetics][105] | [Ent
Specialists][106] | and more, in just 15 minutes.

Benefits of choosing online doctor consultations:
* Save time, money, and effort.
* No need to travel. 
* Most convenient option to choose from, and helps in early diagnosis.
* Online doctor consultations are confidential and safe.
* No risks of infections.

## End-to-End. Built for Integrators. Proven at Scale.

D-Tools provides seamless, end-to-end solutions to manage every aspect of your integration workflow.
From client engagement and project planning to installation and service, D-Tools connects proposals,
resource management, and customer success into one streamlined platform.

Empowering efficiency and innovation, D-Tools frees your team to focus on delivering exceptional
results. It’s more than software—it’s the catalyst driving growth, transformation, and success in
your business.

[circle_web]

## Every Stage of Your Workflow, in One Platform

personalized proposals. Generate precise quotes featuring integrator-specific pricing, elevating
your efficiency and delivering a seamless experience to your clients. Leverage precise estimating
capabilities to guarantee accurate project assessments from start to finish.

costing. Schedule and dispatch field technicians to ensure installation tasks are completed

versus off-the-shelf software that has been adapted from general business solutions. D-Tools' vast
Integrated Product Library contains more than 2 million products from more than 1,200 brands.

Optimize your proposals and system designs with D-Tools’ integrated product library—featuring 1.6
million products from over 1,200 brands, complete with integrator-level pricing. Simplify catalog

## End-to-End. Built for Integrators. Proven at Scale.

D-Tools provides seamless, end-to-end solutions to manage every aspect of your integration workflow.
From client engagement and project planning to installation and service, D-Tools connects proposals,
resource management, and customer success into one streamlined platform.

Empowering efficiency and innovation, D-Tools frees your team to focus on delivering exceptional
results. It’s more than software—it’s the catalyst driving growth, transformation, and success in
your business.

[circle_web]

## Every Stage of Your Workflow, in One Platform

personalized proposals. Generate precise quotes featuring integrator-specific pricing, elevating
your efficiency and delivering a seamless experience to your clients. Leverage precise estimating
capabilities to guarantee accurate project assessments from start to finish.

costing. Schedule and dispatch field technicians to ensure installation tasks are completed
efficiently.

# Welcome to Furstenberg Michael Dr - Dentist and Dental Services

## Your Trusted Dental Care Provider

## About Us

Looking for a reliable and experienced dentist? Look no further! At Furstenberg Michael Dr, we are
committed to providing top-notch dental services to meet your oral health needs. With our team of
skilled professionals and state-of-the-art facilities, we strive to deliver exceptional care in a
comfortable and friendly environment.

## Comprehensive Dentistry Services

As a leading dental practice in the field, we offer a wide range of services to address all your
dental concerns. Whether you need preventive care, restorative treatments, or cosmetic procedures,
our skilled team is here to help you achieve a healthy and beautiful smile.

### Preventive Care

Maintaining good oral hygiene is crucial for overall health. Our preventive care services include
regular dental check-ups, cleanings, and screenings. These routine procedures help in the early
detection and prevention of dental issues, ensuring optimal oral health.

### Restorative Treatments

If you are experiencing dental problems such as cavities, tooth decay, or missing teeth, our
restorative treatments can help you regain your oral health. From dental fillings and root canal
therapy to dental implants and dentures, we offer effective solutions tailored to your specific
needs.

### Cosmetic Dentistry

We understand the importance of a confident smile. Our cosmetic dentistry services aim to enhance
the aesthetic appearance of your teeth. From teeth whitening and veneers to orthodontic treatments
like Invisalign, we can help you achieve the smile you've always desired.

## State-of-the-Art Facilities and Technology

At Furstenberg Michael Dr, we believe in staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in dental
technology. We have equipped our clinic with state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge equipment
to ensure precise diagnostics and effective treatments. Our commitment to utilizing the best
technologies enables us to deliver exceptional results to our valued patients.

## Experienced and Compassionate Dental Team

Our dental team consists of highly skilled professionals who are dedicated to providing personalized
care. We understand that every patient is unique, and we take the time to listen to your concerns
and tailor our treatments accordingly. With our expertise and compassionate approach, we strive to
create a positive dental experience for you and your family.

## Contact Us Today

Your dental health is our priority. If you are in need of dental services, do not hesitate to reach
out to us. Contact Furstenberg Michael Dr today to schedule a consultation or book an appointment.
Our friendly staff will be delighted to assist you.

## Conclusion

Choose Furstenberg Michael Dr for all your dental care needs. With our comprehensive services,
state-of-the-art facilities, and experienced dental team, we are proud to be your trusted partner in
achieving optimal oral health. Contact us today and experience the difference we can make in your
smile!

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Explore the city with OM SYSTEM

### It’s in our nature.

[Buy now][47]

## At OM SYSTEM, we inspire people to get out and capture more of life's moments

by creating unique photo opportunities made possible through handheld shooting. As a brand, we are
committed to delivering on this promise.

[Learn more about the system][48]

## OM Core Technology

### A compact, lightweight system

A compact, lightweight system for long sessions of searching for subjects.

### Powerful image stabilisation

Powerful image stabilisation perfect for stable framing when using a super telephoto lens and for
macro shooting, where camera shake is common.

### Weather-resistant performance

Superior, portable weather-resistant performance for anywhere, from cold climates to deserts.

### Unique lens lineup

A unique, diverse lens lineup that makes it possible to capture something you've never photographed
before.

### Computational photography

Computational photography allows users to process images on the camera without a computer or image
editing software, and to see the effects while shooting.

  The Life Science Solutions and Industrial Solutions products are no longer owned or controlled by
  Olympus Corporation or part of its overall product portfolio. These products are being marketed,
  sold and distributed by Evident.

  Corporation or part of its overall product portfolio. Since January 2021 these products have been

  At Olympus, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to live life to the fullest. Through
  best-in-class solutions and services for early detection, diagnosis and minimally invasive
  treatment, we help people everywhere live a healthy and fulfilling life.

  Our shared aim is to use products and services to make the world safer, healthier and more

致力為您和您的毛孩提供專業及關懷備至的高質素獸醫服務，結合中西療法互相補足，為不同年齡、不同需要的病
患，度身訂造最適切的醫療方案。
[ 了解更多 ][90]
[Yang Sheng Tang icon]

寵生堂

以中醫為主打的獸醫診所，由註冊獸醫提供具國際專業認證的針灸服務，並配合中式養生護理概念，為毛孩提供各
式寵物中醫保健療法，包括推拿、藥浴及中草藥食療等。

[ 了解更多 ][91]

## 關於 Pet Space

## 以獨有及嶄新的體驗
## 與寵物主人攜手迎接每個重要時刻

## MEDUTAINMENT

### Medical Education Entertainment

Pet Space – 全港最大獸醫集團
，並於新加坡擁有一間旗艦獸醫醫院，以其獨有及創新的「Medutainment」概念，從醫療 (Medical)、教育
(Education) 以至娛樂 (Entertainment)
等方面，配合完善殷切的客戶服務，全方位支援您的愛寵在不同的成長階段每項特殊需要。

正如 PET SPACE
的扭計骰標誌一樣，我們具備不同面向，靈活度高，樂於分享各種寵物護理知識，關懷毛孩與主人身心需要，更重
要是我們用心呵護每一位毛孩！

假如您想為動物出一分力，我們誠邀您**[加入我們][92]**的大家庭，以無私的心思與熱誠，與寵物主人共同見證
毛孩生命中每個重要時刻。

## 24小時醫療團隊

位於港島的方舟動物醫院及新界區的元朗專一動物診所提供24小時動物急救及重症護理服務，讓毛孩在長假期或夜
半不適時，隨時得到所需醫療支援。

[專業獸醫團隊]

## 專業獸醫團隊

提供多種寵物手術及護理服務，除常規絕育、牙科護理外，同時提供各種針對急性及慢性疾病的治療。

[12間獸醫診所及醫院網絡]

## 12間獸醫診所及醫院網絡

集團全港12間診所，超過120名前線醫護人員，用心為當區動物提供專業又可靠的醫療服務。

## 立即尋找最靠近你的寵物醫院

[ 查看診所地址 ][93]

## 我們的服務

## 寵物治理及護理服務

我們明白每位毛孩來自不同背景，有不同醫療護理需要。

只有用心聆聽，透過坦誠互信的溝通，才能與飼主一起制定最合適的治療方案。

[老年貓狗護理]

### 老年貓狗護理

毛孩與人一樣會變老，步入老年時需要特別護理。由7歲起定期替貓狗做全面的健康檢查，有助及早發現和預防寵
物患上慢性疾病的機會。適切的護理能讓毛孩晚年生活更舒適，活得更長久。

[了解更多][94]
[寵物牙科保健]

### 寵物牙科保健

牙科疾病是毛孩常見的慢性疾病之一，沒有刷牙習慣的寵物，日常進食又缺乏牙齒護理，易令口腔積聚細菌引起各
種牙科問題，透過恆常牙科檢查及定期洗牙，能大大降低患上齒科疾病的機會。

[了解更多][95]

Pet Space
的獸醫都具備豐富的知識以及專業的技術，為您的愛寵提供最高水平的醫療服務。除內外科診症、疫苗注射、身體
檢查、簽發醫療健康證明外，更引入近年流行的寵物中醫療法，在固有西方醫療基礎上，提供多一種針對痛症及頑
症舒緩、保健養生的選擇。

[更多服務][96]

### 24小時寵物急症

深宵時份，寵物突然出現嚴重不適？公眾假期急需獸醫支援？方舟動物醫院團隊及元朗專一動物診所不分晝夜為寵
物提供緊急診症服務，註冊獸醫24小時駐診，全年無休。遇上緊急情況，不用徬徨，立即致電：2549
2330（方舟動物醫院）；2470 6683 （專一動物診所） 把握治療的黃金時機！

[了解更多][97]
[寵生堂：一站式寵物中西醫診所]

### 寵生堂：一站式寵物中西醫診所

由註冊獸醫在一般西醫問症、化驗診斷以外，同時為毛孩提供各種中式舒緩療法。包括針對痛症、神經或內分泌問
題的針灸服務；處理不同皮膚問題的藥浴治療；保健養生，固本培元的各種藥膳計劃。

[了解更多][98]
[寵物手術治療]

### 寵物手術治療

由經驗豐富的團隊為毛孩進行絕育、骨科及軟組織、腫瘤切除和其他外科手術。我們特別注重動物手術前的身體狀
態評估，及術後的照顧護理，監察傷口復原情況，留心術後照護要點才能讓毛孩更快康復。

[了解更多][99]

## 我們的醫療團隊

超過120名獸醫及助護，具有廣泛的專科經驗

我們知道在主人眼中，寵物是大家最疼愛的家人

所以我們的致力為您提供最專業的診斷、最舒適的治療環境、最細心的護理照顧

在香港長大的 Dr.
Giordanna，自小飼養寵物，童年的美好回憶加上對動物的熱愛，啟發了她日後對獸醫學的興趣。Dr. Giordanna
於 2015 年加入 Pet Space 集團。

希望能透過指導和培訓年輕一代的獸醫，提升本地動物的醫療水平。

熱愛一切貓科動物，無論是「大貓」及小貓。然而，面對可愛的芝娃娃、貴婦狗等小型犬或熱情喧鬧的拉布拉多，
同樣感到無法抗拒。能成功處理複雜的內科病例或異物手術，為 Dr. Mancy 帶來最大的成就感。

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations
Average app rating[4.5 stars]
[CNET, Independent IndyBest and PCMag Editors' Choice]
Recommended by the experts

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]
Mail

#### No trackers. No distractions. Just your email.

VPN

#### Stay protected online, wherever you go.

VPN

#### Ultra-fast gaming, anywhere in the world.

Calendar

#### Organize your schedule privately.

Previous slide
Next slide

## Store, share, collaborate. Securely.

[Proton Drive]

### Proton Drive

Safeguard your files and photos with end-to-end encrypted [cloud storage][151].

[Get it for free][152][Explore Proton Drive
][153]
[Proton Docs]

### Proton Docs

Edit as a team with [collaborative documents][154], safe from prying eyes.

[Get it for free][155][Explore Proton Docs
][156]
[Proton Sheets]

### Proton Sheets

Protect and organize sensitive data in encrypted [online spreadsheets][157].

[Get it for free][158][Explore Proton Sheets
][159]

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

[Proton Pass]

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Get it for free][161][Explore Proton Pass
][162]
[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

[Get it for free][164][Explore Proton Authenticator
][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

> transparent and offering bug bounties, they stay ahead of security threats.

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

## Product Categories

Specializing in medical laser technology, our product portfolio covers a wide range of applications,
including the diagnosis of cardiovascular and peripheral vascular diseases, from intravascular
imaging to vessel visualization and beyond.

  ### [Intravascular OCT Imaging System][62]
  
  Multimodality integration provides a comprehensive solution for vascular intervention, combining
  vulnerable plaque detection, physiology assessment, and calcium assessment to guide treatment
  strategy.

* *02*
  
  ### [Patient Care][64]
  
  Vessel Visualization System uses advanced infrared imaging to project real-time vascular maps onto
  the skin, aiding medical staff in identifying optimal puncture sites. Applicable in Pediatrics,
  Oncology, Emergency Medicine, Vascular Surgery, and other specialties.

mastery of core underlying technologies in laser diagnostics and therapeutics, fiber-optic
catheters, and image processing. This has enabled us to develop a robust "diagnosis and treatment

## ПЭТ/КТ как онкологическое диагностическое исследование

ПЭТ/КТ - диагностическое исследование, которое врач может назначить при онкологических заболеваниях.
Обследование помогает сопоставить данные компьютерной томографии с накоплением радиофармпрепарата,
когда нужно уточнить распространенность процесса, оценить результат лечения или проверить подозрение
на рецидив.
